{{Quote|Aren't you tired of being chestnut all the time, Chewbacca?&hellip;Soon you'll just be one more brindled Wookiee.|Leia Organa Solo to Chewbacca when using color-crawlers to disguise his fur color|<ref name="TCS">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>}}
A '''color-crawler''' was a small creature that exuded a [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Slime/Legends|slime]] as it slid. Color-crawlers were sold for use in many cosmetic applications<ref name="CSWE" /> and came in a variety of colors, including black, silver, and various shades of brown and green. They were sold in packages sorted by color and were stored in their container until use. Once removed from the pack, crawlers could be applied to an individual's [[Hair/Legends|hair]] or fur<ref name="TCS" /> or to cloth.<ref name="CSWE" /> They would then move around the surface that they were set on, dyeing it as they went. If several different colors of crawlers were used together it resulted in streaking.<ref name="TCS" />

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Crystal Star]]'' to [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].</ref> while searching for the [[Kidnapping on Munto Codru|kidnapped]] [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] children&mdash;[[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]]&mdash;their mother, [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used color-crawlers to change the color of their hair so they could disguise themselves as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="TCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Color-crawlers first appeared in ''[[The Crystal Star]]'', a [[1994]] novel written by [[Vonda N. McIntyre]]. They were later given an entry in the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was published in [[2008]].
